faqs.question: What is the puriFlash® 5.250 used for?
faqs.answer: It's a cross-over flash and preparative HPLC purification system, used for routine purification, complex mixture separation, and trace enrichment at 250 mL/min and 250 bar.

faqs.question: How does Genius build a purification method automatically?
faqs.answer: Enter the elution results from a TLC plate or analytical chromatogram, and Genius implements the purification method based on that data directly.

faqs.question: How do I detect chromophore-free compounds?
faqs.answer: Add the iELSD pack, which integrates ELSD detection specifically for compounds that don't absorb UV light.

faqs.question: How do I run multiple columns at once?
faqs.answer: Add the Multi-Pack, which increases column support to up to 3 flash and/or preparative columns simultaneously.

faqs.question: What columns is the 5.250 compatible with?
faqs.answer: All flash and preparative columns up to 80mm internal diameter.

faqs.question: Can I monitor a purification run remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, the system supports remote monitoring, letting you start and track runs from your office.

faqs.question: How does RFID detection work on this system?
faqs.answer: It automatically detects columns, dry load, injection loops, and racks, reducing manual setup and setup errors.

faqs.question: What's the difference between the base UV detector and the UVextended pack?
faqs.answer: The base detector covers 200-400nm; UVextended extends that into the visible range, 200-800nm.

faqs.question: What is the price of the puriFlash® 5.250 in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on your base configuration and which optional packs you add. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your requirements are confirmed.

faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Advion Interchim Scientific puriFlash® 5.250 in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

sections.tabSummary: What AI-assisted method generation actually does
body: Software here does two jobs: making the instrument itself easy to run, and taking method development off your hands entirely when you want it to.

Genius goes further: enter the elution results from a TLC plate or an analytical chromatogram, and it builds the purification method automatically, with method transfer features that support progressively more automated operation. Remote monitoring means starting and tracking that run doesn't require standing at the instrument.

faqs.question: What is the puriFlash® 5.400-UV used for?
faqs.answer: It's an ultra-high-pressure preparative purification system, used for method development and purification of rare, high-value samples requiring maximum resolution.

faqs.question: What does the 400 bar pressure actually enable?
faqs.answer: It's what makes sub-2-micron column compatibility possible, delivering the separating power standard preparative HPLC systems don't reach.

faqs.question: How do I choose between the 5.400-UV and 5.250?
faqs.answer: Choose the 5.400-UV when resolution matters more than throughput for rare or valuable samples; choose the 5.250 when you need higher flow rate, larger columns, or triple detection for routine to complex purification.

faqs.question: How does method development work on this system?
faqs.answer: Develop your method on a 7.8mm analytical column, then move directly to purification on a preparative HPLC column, on the same apparatus.

faqs.question: How does mobile phase heating improve my results?
faqs.answer: It holds the mobile phase at a constant temperature regardless of your lab's ambient conditions, improving reproducibility and sharpening peaks.

faqs.question: How does the solvent level detector protect my column?
faqs.answer: It warns you before a solvent bottle runs empty, preventing air from entering and damaging the preparative HPLC column.

faqs.question: What optional packs are available for the 5.400-UV?
faqs.answer: UVextended, for detection range up to 800nm, and PWD, which rinses pump heads to prevent piston crystallization.

faqs.question: Does the 5.400-UV have the same RFID and software as the 5.250?
faqs.answer: Yes, both share the same RFID component detection and ClearPeak/Genius software platform.

faqs.question: What is the price of the puriFlash® 5.400-UV in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on your configuration and optional packs. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your resolution and throughput requirements are confirmed.

faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Advion Interchim Scientific puriFlash® 5.400-UV in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

sections.title: Ultra-High Pressure and Sub-2-Micron Separation
body: 400 bar isn't a headline number here, it's the specific requirement sub-2-micron columns demand to function at all.

That pressure ceiling is what genuinely separates this system's capability from standard preparative HPLC, giving access to the resolving power needed for rare or high-value products where losing material to a poor separation isn't an option. Mobile phase heating and solvent level detection both support that same goal from different angles: temperature stability keeps peaks sharp and results reproducible, while the solvent detectors protect the column itself from the air-ingress damage that running a bottle dry would otherwise cause.
